stem:
Gaurav has seven odd-numbered cards. He wants to place all seven cards so that their sum is exactly $40$.

What can he decide before trying any cases?

options.text: Call possible selection the answer, and ignore odd and even.
Treat the total $40$ as reachable with seven odd cards, dropping the parity of seven odds.
The sum is impossible, because seven odd numbers have an odd sum and $40$ is even.
First pick any seven odd cards, and say that choice is what creates the target total $40$.

teacher.key_rationale: Seven odds sum to an odd total; 40 is even, so the target is impossible before any case hunt. Naming selection alone, dropping parity, or reversing that the pick creates the target miss the parity test.
